Journalist Accuses Netflix of Plagiarizing Life Story for Film

Investigative journalist Sandhya Ravishankar has accused Netflix India and the makers of the film 'Reporting Live' of plagiarizing elements of her real-life journalistic career without credit. Ravishankar stated in a public post that she had previously pitched her life story, alleging that the film's portrayal, including the character played by Parineeti Chopra, was based on her experiences.
